prompt: A CPG company has 6 candidate digital initiatives but budget for only 3 this year. Using the data given, recommend which 3 to fund and justify the sequencing.
context: Initiatives (estimated annual value / one-time cost / delivery risk, internal estimates): (1) E-commerce personalization engine — $1.8M value, $600K cost, medium risk (depends on a data platform not yet built). (2) Retail media analytics dashboard — $900K value, $250K cost, low risk. (3) Supply-chain demand forecasting AI — $2.4M value, $900K cost, high risk (unproven internally, would be first ML deployment). (4) Consumer mobile app redesign — $500K value, $400K cost, low risk. (5) Trade promotion optimization tool — $1.1M value, $350K cost, medium risk. (6) Loyalty program overhaul — $700K value, $500K cost, medium risk. Total available budget: $1.2M.

binaryCriteria.description: The recommended set of initiatives fits within the stated $1.2M budget rather than simply listing the highest-value initiatives regardless of cost.
binaryCriteria.guidance: Fail if the recommended combination of initiatives sums to materially more than $1.2M without an explicit phasing/partial-funding explanation.

binaryCriteria.description: Reasons using value-to-cost efficiency (or an equivalent ratio-based argument), not just picking the initiatives with the largest absolute dollar value.
binaryCriteria.guidance: Fail if the #3 highest-value initiative (demand forecasting, $2.4M) is selected despite consuming most of the budget and carrying flagged high risk, with no acknowledgment of that tradeoff.

binaryCriteria.description: Explicitly explains why the high-value, high-risk demand-forecasting initiative is deferred rather than silently omitting it.
binaryCriteria.guidance: Fail if demand forecasting is dropped from the answer with no explanation.

goldNotes: A strong answer computes value-to-cost ratios (or equivalent) to rank initiatives: Retail media dashboard (3.6x), Trade promotion tool (3.1x), E-commerce personalization (3.0x), Loyalty overhaul (1.4x), Mobile app redesign (1.25x), Demand forecasting (2.7x but high risk/dependency). A naive "pick the 3 highest absolute value" answer would wrongly select demand forecasting ($2.4M) despite it alone consuming 75% of the $1.2M budget and carrying unproven-technology risk. The strong answer respects the $1.2M budget constraint (not just ranks by value) and should recommend a combination that fits the budget — e.g., Retail media dashboard + Trade promotion tool + E-commerce personalization ($250K+$350K+$600K = $1.2M, exactly at budget) — while explicitly flagging that the highest-absolute-value initiative (demand forecasting) is deliberately deferred due to cost and risk, not ignored, and recommending it be revisited for next year's budget cycle or piloted at smaller scope.
